name: Informative image without alt attribute
expectedCondition: Informative images must expose a text alternative.
failureCondition: Image element has no alt attribute and no ARIA label.
humanJudgementRequired: Determining whether the image conveys essential information vs decorative.
verificationEvidence: Screen reader announces generic file name or ignores image; no accessible name in devtools.

name: Icon button with empty alt inside
expectedCondition: Actionable graphical buttons must have non-empty text alternative.
failureCondition: Button contains only an image with alt="" and has no other labeling.
verificationEvidence: Screen reader announces "button" without any name or purpose.

name: SVG graphic button without accessible name
expectedCondition: Inline SVG controls must expose an accessible name.
failureCondition: Button contains inline SVG without title, aria-label or text alternative.
verificationEvidence: Screen reader speaks unlabelled button; AX Tree name is empty.
html: <button id="target-element"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20"><path d="M5 5l10 10M15 5L5 15"/></svg></button>

name: Informative image with meaningful alt text
expectedCondition: Informative image provides accurate descriptive alternative text.
failureCondition: None.
humanJudgementRequired: Verification that "Annual sales growth diagram" accurately represents image content.
verificationEvidence: NVDA announces "Annual sales growth diagram graphic".

name: Decorative background icon hidden with aria-hidden
expectedCondition: Purely decorative non-text content is ignored by assistive technology.
failureCondition: None.
verificationEvidence: Screen reader does not announce decorative star; parent heading has visible text.
html: Featured Article

name: Visual heading styled using div without semantic heading or role
expectedCondition: Visual section headings must be programmatically determined as headings.
failureCondition: Visual header rendered with styled div without role="heading" or aria-level.
humanJudgementRequired: Determining if text visually functions as a section header.
verificationEvidence: Assistive tech does not include text in heading navigation list.
html: Chapter 1: Research Methodology

name: Form input without programmatic label association
expectedCondition: Form controls must have programmatically determinable labels.
failureCondition: Input has nearby text label but lacks for/id association or ARIA label.
verificationEvidence: Focusing input in NVDA announces "edit, blank" with no label.
html: Email Address:

expectedCondition: Information presented as a list must expose list and listitem semantics.
failureCondition: Bullet symbols with line breaks used instead of ul/ol and li.
humanJudgementRequired: Confirming sequence of items represents a conceptual list.
verificationEvidence: Screen reader does not announce list item count or list structure.
html:

name: Form input correctly associated with label for and id
expectedCondition: Explicit label element associated via for and id attributes.
failureCondition: None.
verificationEvidence: Focusing input announces "Telephone number, edit".

name: Semantic data table with th headers and scope attributes
expectedCondition: Data tables programmatically associate headers with data cells.
failureCondition: None.

name: Custom button made of div with onclick but no keyboard handler or tabindex
interactionSteps: Attempt to reach control using Tab key.
expectedCondition: All interactive functionality must be operable via keyboard interface.
failureCondition: Div has click handler but is not in the tab order (tabindex missing).
verificationEvidence: Tab key skips over element entirely; cannot activate with Enter or Space.
html: Submit Request

name: Custom control with tabindex=0 but missing keyboard event listeners
interactionSteps: Tab to element and press Enter and Space.
expectedCondition: Focusable custom button must respond to Enter and Space keys.
failureCondition: Control receives focus via tabindex="0" but only listens to click event without keydown.
verificationEvidence: Element receives visual focus ring, but pressing Enter or Space triggers no action.
html:

expectedCondition: Anchor acting as link must have valid href to be keyboard focusable.
failureCondition: Anchor element has onclick but no href attribute and no tabindex.

name: SPA route change fails to update document title
preconditions: Initial view loaded with title "Home | WCAG Test Bed".
interactionSteps: Navigate to view B via client-side router without updating document.title.
expectedCondition: Web page title must update to describe new topic or purpose upon navigation.
failureCondition: Document title remains static ("Home | WCAG Test Bed") after routing to User Profile view.
humanJudgementRequired: Determining if title adequately describes new view.
verificationEvidence: NVDA title readout does not reflect page change after SPA navigation.
html: Home Content

expectedCondition: Web page must have a non-empty, descriptive title.
failureCondition: document.title is whitespace or empty string.

name: Document title set to generic non-descriptive string
expectedCondition: Page title must describe the topic or purpose of the page.
failureCondition: Title is generic ("Untitled Document" or "Page").

verificationEvidence: Screen reader announces non-descriptive title.
html: Report Content

name: SPA route change dynamically updates document title to descriptive string

name: Static test page with informative, unique title

name: Modal dialog opens without moving focus to dialog content
expectedCondition: When modal dialog opens, focus must move into dialog.
failureCondition: Focus remains on triggering button or body when modal is displayed.

name: Modal dialog fails to restore focus to trigger element on close
expectedCondition: Closing modal must restore focus to the trigger control.
failureCondition: Focus is lost or resets to body tag upon dialog close.
verificationEvidence: After closing modal, document.activeElement is body rather than trigger button.
html: Settings Dialog

name: Positive tabindex disrupts logical sequential focus order
expectedCondition: Focusable elements must receive focus in an order preserving meaning and operability.
failureCondition: Element has tabindex="5" while surrounding elements have default (0), hijacking tab order.
humanJudgementRequired: Determining if reading/operation sequence is impaired.
verificationEvidence: Tab key jumps directly to field 3 before fields 1 and 2.

name: Modal dialog fails to trap focus allowing tab into background inert DOM
preconditions: Modal open with focus on first input.
interactionSteps: Tab past last element in modal dialog.
expectedCondition: Focus should wrap within the active modal and not escape to background controls.
failureCondition: Tabbing from close button moves focus to background link.
verificationEvidence: Tab leaves modal and highlights background links obscured beneath overlay.
html:
Background Link

interactionSteps: Open modal, verify focus inside, close modal, verify focus restored to trigger.
expectedCondition: Focus moves into dialog upon open, is contained inside, and returns to trigger upon close.
failureCondition: None.
verificationEvidence: document.activeElement shifts into dialog, traps correctly, and restores to button on ESC/close.

name: Button with visible text entirely omitted from aria-label
interactionSteps: Inspect button accessible name vs visible text.
expectedCondition: For controls with visible text label, the accessible name must contain the visible text.
failureCondition: Button visible text is "Delete Record" but aria-label is "Remove Item" (does not include visible words).
verificationEvidence: Speech-input user speaking "Click Delete Record" fails to activate button because name is "Remove Item".
html: <button id="target-element" aria-label="Remove Item">Delete Record</button>

name: Link with visible text completely mismatched with aria-label
interactionSteps: Inspect link accessible name vs visible text.
expectedCondition: The accessible name of a link must contain its visible text label.
failureCondition: Visible text is "Download Guide" while aria-label is "Get Whitepaper".
verificationEvidence: Speech navigation command "Click Download Guide" fails.
html: Download Guide

name: Submit button with aria-labelledby referencing different offscreen string
interactionSteps: Inspect computed name from aria-labelledby vs visible text.
expectedCondition: Accessible name computed from aria-labelledby must include the visible text.
failureCondition: Visible text is "Send Message" but aria-labelledby points to element with text "Transmit Telemetry".
verificationEvidence: Speech input voice commands matching visual text do not trigger control.
html: Transmit Telemetry

name: Button with aria-label that expands on visible text starting with it
interactionSteps: Inspect button accessible name vs visible text.
expectedCondition: Accessible name contains the visible text verbatim.
failureCondition: None.
verificationEvidence: Speech user saying "Click Read More" triggers control; name is "Read More about WCAG 2.2".
html: <button id="target-element" aria-label="Read More about WCAG 2.2">Read More</button>

name: Standard button with accessible name derived directly from inner text
interactionSteps: Inspect button accessible name vs visible text.
expectedCondition: Computed accessible name matches visible text exactly.
failureCondition: None.
verificationEvidence: 100% string equality between visible label and computed accessible name.
html: <button id="target-element" type="button">Save Changes</button>

name: Required input with placeholder used as sole label without persistent label
expectedCondition: Labels or instructions are provided when content requires user input.
failureCondition: Input has placeholder="Enter password" but no persistent visible label or programmatic label.
humanJudgementRequired: Assessing if placeholder vanishes on entry creating memory burden.
verificationEvidence: Once value is typed, placeholder disappears leaving control with zero label.
html: <input type="text" placeholder="Enter password" required id="target-element">

name: Required field indicated solely by red border without text or asterisk
expectedCondition: Required inputs must provide clear labels or instructions indicating requirement.
failureCondition: Input has required attribute but no visible text or aria-required indicating requirement.
verificationEvidence: Screen reader does not announce that field is mandatory.
html: <label for="target-element">Billing Address</label><input type="text" id="target-element" class="border-red-required">

name: Date input with mandatory format but no format instructions provided
expectedCondition: Inputs with specific expected formats must provide instructions.
failureCondition: Input strictly requires DD/MM/YYYY but label only states "Date" with no format instruction.
humanJudgementRequired: Evaluating whether format requirements are communicated to user.
verificationEvidence: User receives validation error on standard input without prior instructional guidance.
html: <label for="target-element">Date</label><input type="text" id="target-element" pattern="\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}">

name: Compliant disclosure widget with proper role, name, and dynamic aria-expanded
interactionSteps: Click disclosure button, inspect aria-expanded toggle from false to true.

name: Dynamic async status message injected into container without live region properties
interactionSteps: Click submit button to dynamically inject "Data saved successfully" into plain div.
expectedCondition: Status messages must be presented to assistive technologies via live regions without focus shift.
failureCondition: Success message injected into plain <div> without aria-live, role="status", or role="alert".
humanJudgementRequired: Distinguishing whether text constitutes a status message vs primary content change.
verificationEvidence: Message appears visually, but screen reader remains silent because container is not an active live region.

name: Dynamic error message added without role=alert or aria-live=assertive
interactionSteps: Click Validate button to inject validation error text.
expectedCondition: Error status messages must be exposed as live regions.
failureCondition: Error text injected into non-live container; assistive technology not notified.
verificationEvidence: Screen reader does not announce validation error.

name: Live region dynamically created at moment of message injection (race condition)
interactionSteps:
Click button to dynamically create `
Saved
` simultaneously with content.
expectedCondition: Live region should exist in DOM prior to text injection so browser registers mutation listeners.
failureCondition: Live region container created simultaneously with text, often dropped by screen reader engines.
humanJudgementRequired: Understanding timing limitations across screen reader engines.
verificationEvidence: Screen readers frequently miss announcement when role="status" is injected along with text in one paint.

name: Status message container has aria-live=off explicitly suppressing announcements
interactionSteps: Click button to update content inside aria-live="off" container.
expectedCondition: Status message regions must allow announcements (polite or assertive).
failureCondition: Container has aria-live="off", explicitly muting status updates.
verificationEvidence: ARIA live property is computed as "off"; screen reader ignores text updates.

name: Compliant status message using persistent role=status and aria-live=polite
preconditions: Persistent empty `<div role="status" aria-live="polite">` present in initial DOM.
interactionSteps: Click button to update text content inside pre-existing live region.
expectedCondition: Status message is injected into existing polite live region, announcing without focus disruption.
failureCondition: None.
humanJudgementRequired: Distinguishing live property presence from speech queue delivery.
verificationEvidence: CDP Accessibility Tree reports role="status" and live="polite"; NVDA announces message automatically.
